Save at least 10% when buying a pack vs buying singles on downlights – 6 pack code 869RE.

This Saxby CosmosEco V3 Fixed Fire-Rated LED Recessed Downlight offers an efficient and safe lighting solution for various indoor applications. Designed for reliability, this integrated LED downlight provides a cool white 4000K illumination with 500 lumens, making it ideal for bathroom lighting in Zone 1, kitchens, or commercial spaces where durability and moisture protection are essential. Installation is quick and simple for trade professionals, featuring a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block and requiring only a standard 57mm holesaw for fitting. The dimmable function allows for flexible lighting control, and its robust steel body with IP65 rating ensures a long-lasting performance of 50,000 hours.
